reason: My bookkeeper already puts everything into the app we use and it works well enough, and half my spending is cash to mechanics with no receipt anyway. I might throw the free 30 at it out of curiosity, but I'm not paying $19 a month for a second system that does what the first one mostly does.
objection: I don't believe it really catches a duplicate when the same scooter part shows up once as a shop receipt and again as a transfer screenshot from a different guy. If it's just turning photos into rows, my bookkeeper already does that, and now I'd have a Google Sheet and Jurnal to keep in sync.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 30 documents showed me a real double payment or padded receipt from my own staff that my current setup missed, and it could send the data into the app my bookkeeper already uses instead of a separate sheet.
